method: cheap Lowlevel headless desktop (ChromeStatesDesktop) launching the built dist/main+dist/renderer Electron app with --remote-debugging-port, isolated single-target CDP session verified via scripts/cdp-isolated-session.mjs; seeds the chrome save with real Diesel Factory equipment (4 crude_well, 4 refinery_still, 3 storage_tank, crude and litres already in the line) so the pipe/derrick chrome is actively RUNNING rather than idle; sets Emulation.setEmulatedMedia to prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, reloads, verifies window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches is true, opens the Diesel Factory panel, and captures the running line under the reduced-motion media query; Page.captureScreenshot
